title: Bestsad Verification Score v0.1
description: Spec 19.1: fitness records both verification coverage (the fraction of the declared domain covered by strong evidence, stated, never estimated) and verification cost (the compute spent establishing it). Emitted per solver-backed claim by the verification plane (BESTSAD_VERIFICATION_PLANE_ENG_v0.1 section 2.5). This schema is new in the verification plane and is not part of the pinned v0.2 package.

verification_coverage.description: 1.0 when every bound is exact for the declared types; otherwise the product of the bound ratios that applied. Never an estimate.

coverage_basis.description: How the coverage figure was computed, in words, so a reader can dispute it.

scope.description: The resolved solver scope: list_bound, int_abs_limit, timeout_ms, unroll_depth.

analyzer_result_ref.description: Content id of the SRE analyzer-result record holding the SMT-LIB2 text, solver version and timing.
